Only if it was short and about games, with no long reading. Mum would probably help me, but I would not tell friends yet. Lots of reading on the TV also tired me out.

findings.evidence: #6 goal text for creeper and football topics
findings.suggested_acceptance: Goals for a near pre-A1 child name one word or one 'I like' sentence.
